design_description: A sleek, premium look with a primarily black base. Thin gold lines run along the sides and shoulder seams, giving a subtle frame to the silhouette. The front is clean, with a minimalist emblem on the chest and the SL7 logo in gold, while the back mirrors the black-and-gold scheme with the player name and number in matching gold typography. Overall, the design feels modern, sharp, and understatedly luxurious, emphasizing form and contrast rather than complex patterns.
